CalibrationPoint

class CalibrationPoint(pointx1, pointy1, pointx2, pointy2, pointx3, pointy3, pointx4, pointy4)[source]

Bases: object

Four corner points of the calibrated projection area.

Attributes:
pointx1, pointy1int

Coordinates of the first corner.

pointx2, pointy2int

Coordinates of the second corner.

pointx3, pointy3int

Coordinates of the third corner.

pointx4, pointy4int

Coordinates of the fourth corner.

PROPERTIESlist[str], class attribute

Field names, filled by initialize_reflexive.

DATA_PROPERTIESlist, class attribute

Field defaults, filled by initialize_reflexive.

ID_VALUEint, class attribute

Fixed identifier of the single calibration point record (1).

Notes

TODO(doc): confirm the corner order and the coordinate space (screen or camera pixels).

Examples

>>> p = CalibrationPoint(0, 0, 640, 0, 0, 480, 640, 480)
>>> p.set_data({"pointx1": 10})
>>> p.get_data()[0]["pointx1"]
10

Methods

get_data

Return the field values as a one-item list.

set_data

Update the fields from a dictionary.
set_data(data)[source]

Update the fields from a dictionary.

Parameters:
datadict

Values keyed by field name. Keys that are not fields are ignored, and fields missing from data keep their value.

Notes

No validation or type conversion is done.

get_data()[source]

Return the field values as a one-item list.

Returns:
list[dict]

A list with one dictionary that maps each name of PROPERTIES to its current value.
